exposure: oocyte maturation stage (Metaphase I, Metaphase II, Germinal Vesicle)
cohort: The study included 250 poor-prognosis patients who underwent 311 assisted reproductive technology (ART) cycles, with 2243 oocytes analyzed, where DICSI was offered based on oocyte maturity, fertilization rates, or genetic testing needs.
finding: Delayed intracytoplasmic sperm injection (DICSI) in poor-prognosis patients significantly increased overall ART cycle success by rescuing late-maturing oocytes, which produced blastocysts with similar euploidy and live birth rates compared to metaphase II oocytes.
mod_finding: No differences in delivery method were found between intracytoplasmic sperm injection and DICSI.
